answer: Because the signal index resolves every citation against the ember checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the raven audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Copying the same citations across 81 aliases therefore pays the authoring cost 81 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature.
